concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading the '2025 CO2 hydrogenation study dataset (Doe et al., 2025)'. The plan substitutes 'locuslab/TOFU' and marks FR-001 'Partial / Unmet'. A plan cannot satisfy an FR it declares unmet; the spec's dataset requirement is unverifiable and must be revised at the spec level (kickback to clarified) — either replace the FR-001 dataset with a real, open TOF source or formally amend the FR. Note also that locuslab/TOFU is a question-answering corpus, not a catalytic TOF collection, so even the surrogate claim does not map to FR-001's intent.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 / Project Structure vs spec.md:FR-002, SC-002
concerns.text: FR-002/SC-002 require the alignment success rate recorded in 'alignment_metrics.json'. The plan's outputs list only 'alignment_log.json' and Phase 3 says 'Alignment rate recorded (SC-002)' without naming the required artifact. Either produce alignment_metrics.json or the spec must be amended to the new filename.

FR-003 requires post-scaling verification (|mu|<0.01, |sigma-1|<0.01) logged in 'scaling_report.json'. Phase 5 (Scaling) mentions StandardScaler but no scaling_report.json appears anywhere in the plan, data-model, or quickstart outputs.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 6 / quickstart.md step 5 vs spec.md:FR-004, SC-006
concerns.text: FR-004 requires selected hyper-parameters saved to 'best_params.json'; quickstart step 5 lists only 'code/models/best_xgboost.json' and 'outputs/metrics.json'. SC-006's leakage verification is defined as confirming best_params.json was generated without accessing test_set/*.csv — with no best_params.json and no test_set/ directory in the plan, SC-006 has no verification mechanism.

FR-005 explicitly requires 'normality_test.json' and 'statistical_test.json' as output artifacts. Phase 7 describes the Shapiro-Wilk/test-selection logic but the plan's outputs contain neither file (only performance_summary.json and metrics.json).

FR-006 requires 'shap_rankings.csv' (checksum-verified) and 'shap_barplot.png'. The plan/quickstart instead produce 'outputs/shap_ranking.json' and 'outputs/feature_importance.png'. Filename mismatch means the FR's named artifacts will never exist.

FR-001 specifies download 'via wget' and verification via 'required_columns.json'. The plan uses datasets streaming / mp-api and never mentions required_columns.json. If the download mechanism and verification artifact are intentionally changed, the spec should be amended; otherwise add required_columns.json generation to Phase 1.

FR-005 specifies 'a linear regression baseline'; the plan uses Elastic Net (l1_ratio=0.5). This is a defensible strengthening but is an unpinned deviation from the FR text — either annotate the plan with the rationale tied to FR-005 or amend the spec.
